subject.title: La Habra City School District Board, Trustee Area 4

text: La Habra has been my home for more than 22 years, where my husband and I proudly raised our two children. They are both graduates of the La Habra City School District and have become productive citizens in their communities.

I recently retired after 35 years of public service, including 25 years with the California Department of Social Services, where I served in leadership roles dedicated to protecting the health, safety, and well-being of children in both Los Angeles & Orange County. Throughout my career, I have partnered with families, educators, and community organizations to help children learn, grow, and thrive.
As your School Board Trustee, I will focus on three priorities:
Strengthening academic excellence by ensuring every student builds a strong foundation in reading, writing, mathematics, and science
Supporting parents by protecting their rights to be involved in their children's education and expanding educational opportunities.
Promoting transparency, accountability, and fiscal responsibility.
I will bring integrity, experience, and a commitment to putting students first, supporting our teachers, and preparing every child for lifelong success.
Guided by Faith. Dedicated to Families. Committed to Students.

text: Governing Board Member, La Habra City School District

My name is Adam Rogers, an academic research director at USC, parent of two former La Habra students, and husband of a public school teacher. For eight years, I have been honored to serve on the La Habra City School Board, working to strengthen our schools and support students, families, teachers, and staff.

During my service, I helped hire our superintendent, Dr. Carlos, supported policies that protect and welcome immigrant families, and worked collaboratively to help our educational community become stronger, more stable, and successful. I have advocated for responsible use of taxpayer dollars, high-quality programs, inclusive schools, and decisions focused on student achievement and well-being.

My family has directly benefited from the dedicated personnel and programs at Washington Middle School, Sierra Vista, Ladera Palma, El Cerrito, Las Lomas, and KidZone. I have helped support programs, including the amazing International Baccalaureate programs at Imperial and Las Positas.

I bring 25 years of management and community service experience, a master’s degree from USC, and a bachelor’s degree from Cal State LA. I remain committed to excellence, innovation, transparency, and ensuring La Habra’s diverse students receive the opportunities and support they deserve. I would be honored to earn your vote for re-election.
